Metadata.title: KOVELIA — AI, data and platforms for business
Metadata.description: KOVELIA builds AI agents and RAG assistants, analytics platforms, scrapers, niche CRMs, server infrastructure and C++ systems software. We work with companies directly under contract.

Hero.subtitle: We fine-tune language models, build analytics platforms and reliable infrastructure. One team from the first briefing to post-launch support.

Directions.title: The full cycle — from data to production
Directions.subtitle: Four directions that reinforce each other: AI relies on data, data on infrastructure, infrastructure on reliable systems software.

Case.title: KOVELIA Agro — an agribusiness registry built on open data
Case.subtitle: Our own product: we turned scattered government data into a convenient tool for grain traders and producers.
features: Interactive map of producers by region

Process.title: How we work
Process.subtitle: Predictable and transparent — you see progress at every stage instead of waiting for the finale.

steps.title: Briefing
steps.text: A call or a meeting to understand the task, the data and the constraints. No upselling.

steps.title: Technical proposal
steps.text: A concrete plan: stack, stages, timeline and budget. A contract with a legal entity.

steps.title: Development
steps.text: Iterations with regular demos. You see progress instead of waiting for the end.

steps.title: Handover & support
steps.text: Deployment, documentation, team training if needed. Support after launch.

Pricing.title: Indicative prices
Pricing.note: The final cost is set after the briefing. Prices exclude VAT. Long-term projects have separate terms.

Stack.title: Technologies we work with every day

items.a: Directly with companies, no middlemen. We work under contract as a legal entity (LLC) remotely across Russia.

items.q: How much does a project cost?
items.a: See the Pricing section for guidance — for example, an AI agent from ₽60,000 and a scraper from ₽30,000. We give an exact quote after the briefing, once scope and requirements are clear.
Within one business day. Then we suggest a time for a short call to go through the task.

items.q: What if the scope isn't clear yet?
items.a: We start with a consultation or time & material: research and prototype first, then fix the budget once things are clear.

items.q: Who owns the code and data?
items.a: You do. On handover you receive the source code, access credentials and documentation. Your data is used only for your project.

items.q: Do you support projects after launch?
items.a: Yes. We maintain infrastructure and applications: monitoring, updates, quick fixes — from ₽25,000 per month.

Cta.title: Tell us about your task — we'll propose an approach
Cta.subtitle: We'll estimate the scope, pick the stack and name the timeline. We reply within one business day.

Services.title: Service catalog
Services.subtitle: We deploy AI agents, fine-tune language models, build analytics platforms and develop Linux systems software.

About.title: An engineering team that delivers results
About.subtitle: KOVELIA stands for data, intelligence and platforms. We combine machine learning, data engineering and reliable infrastructure into products people use every day.
About.missionText: We don't sell technology for its own sake. First we understand the process, the data and the constraints, then we propose the simplest solution that gets results. We also build our own products, such as KOVELIA Agro, so we know what it's like to live with a system after launch.
About.principlesTitle: What working with us is built on

principles.title: Direct
principles.text: You talk to the engineers who write the code. No middlemen, nothing lost in translation.

principles.title: Transparent
principles.text: Iterations with regular demos. You see progress and can change course at any time.

principles.title: Reliable
principles.text: Monitoring, backups and documentation are part of the job, not an option.

principles.title: Lean
principles.text: We build what your team needs, not everything that can be sold.
